title: Sentence Order · Q2 W03 D04
objective: Use sequence words to show the order of events or ideas.
introduction: First, next, then, finally — order words! 🐱✨ Help Milo put the fruit snack steps in order.

vocabulary.definition: The first step: wash the fruit before cutting it.
The second step: cut the fruit with care.
The third step: share the fruit with others.

items.explanation: Washing comes first so the fruit is clean before it is cut.

items.prompt: After washing the fruit, which step comes NEXT?
items.explanation: After washing, the next step is cutting the fruit safely.

items.prompt: Which step comes AFTER cutting the fruit?
items.explanation: Sharing comes after cutting, so "Then, share it" is the next step.
Cleaning up is the last step, after the fruit is shared.

items.prompt: Which choice shows the correct order?

options.text: First, wash the fruit. Next, cut it safely. Then, share it. Finally, clean up.
First, wash the fruit. Then, share it. Next, cut it safely. Finally, clean up.
Finally, clean up. Then, share it. Next, cut it safely. First, wash the fruit.
Next, cut it safely. First, wash the fruit. Then, share it. Finally, clean up.

items.explanation: The correct order is wash, cut, share, clean — each step uses a sequence word.
